jobs.title: Global Program Manager
jobs.location: Tempe, Arizona, United States Of America
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

At Avnet, relationships matter. We are a global, FORTUNE ® 500 technology distributor and solutions company that delivers design, supply chain and logistics expertise to customers at every stage of a product’s lifecycle. Our employees have a front row seat to the latest innovations shaping the world we live in and the future we share. We’re driven to help our customers around the world succeed and we do so by earning the trust of some of the biggest names in technology.

Working at Avnet means being a part of a global team. We work collaboratively and with integrity, doing business the right way. For more than a century, we have partnered together to help our customers, suppliers and teammates realize the transformative possibilities of technology. Experience what’s next at Avnet!

Job Summary:
Plans, leads, monitors and coordinates activities related to technology and business projects and programs. Manages projects or assigned projects subcomponents to ensure cost, schedule, scope and deliverable requirements are met. Interfaces and communicates progress of projects.

Principal Responsibilities:
- Using project management principals, theories, techniques and tools, manages time, cost, schedules, quality, procurement, communication, and risk.
- Directs and coordinates activities of assigned project personnel to ensure project progresses on schedule and within budget. Provides leadership of project team members throughout the project lifecycle.
- Determines methods and resources needed to achieve project goals, and develops and maintains a detailed work (project) plan.
- Coordinates activities and works collaboratively with all stakeholders across global departments.
- Facilitates meetings to discuss issues and implementation strategies and solicit alternative points of view. Facilitates problem-solving; and decision-making.
- Formulates conclusions, recommendations and develops options. Effectively presents and justifies findings and recommendations to management and customers, as appropriate, to gain approval.
- May manage projects and programs that cross multiple departments/regions throughout the company.
- May manage vendor relationships and serve as a liaison between vendors and project team members and leadership. May manage vendors including cost, quality, and schedules.
- Identifies, manages and mitigates issues and risks.
- Other duties as assigned.

Job Level Specifications:
- Mastery knowledge of industry best practices and disciplines. Considered a subject matter expert within the organization and contributes to the development of new concepts, techniques and standards.
- Develops solutions to highly complex and uniquely challenging situations. Assignments require extensive evaluation of alternatives and variables. Expected to make improvements to policies and procedures.
- Works independently toward long-range goals and objectives. Assignments are often self-initiated using independent judgment and discretion. May act as informal team lead and/or coach less experienced team members.
- Serves as consultant to management and/or internal/external spokesperson for the organization on major initiatives related to policies, plans and long-range objectives.
- Ability to engage and influence at all levels of the global organization.

Work Experience:
- Typically 8+ years with bachelor's or equivalent.

Education and Certification(s):
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience from which comparable knowledge and job skills can be obtained.

Distinguishing Characteristics:
- Works on more large scale, complex, high risk projects including GIS projects

#LI-AMER

Our total rewards strategy supports Avnet’s ability to attract, engage, develop, and reward our employees, while promoting a diverse and inclusive environment. We offer competitive compensation and benefit programs — from time away and flexible working arrangements to programs supporting employee well-being and opportunities to give back to your community.

- 401K and Pension Plan

Job Summary:
The Business Process & AI Solutions Manager is responsible for driving business transformation through process improvement, advanced analytics, automation, and Artificial Intelligence (AI). This role partners with business leaders, operational teams, and technology organizations to identify opportunities, solve complex business challenges, and deliver scalable solutions that improve efficiency, productivity, and decision-making.

The successful candidate will combine strong business acumen with modern technology capabilities to redesign processes, leverage data-driven insights, and accelerate adoption of automation and AI-enabled solutions. This role is ideal for someone who is equally comfortable leading business transformation initiatives, analyzing data, and exploring emerging technologies to create measurable business value.

Principal Responsibilities:
Business Process Transformation

- Lead business process improvement and operational excellence initiatives across global functions.

- Identify inefficiencies, risks, and opportunities to improve performance, scalability, and user experience.

- Partner with business stakeholders to redesign processes using automation-first and AI-enabled approaches.

- Establish success metrics and measure the impact of transformation initiatives.

Analytics & Business Intelligence

- Develop dashboards, reporting solutions, KPI frameworks, and analytical models to support decision-making.

- Analyze complex datasets to identify trends, opportunities, and actionable business insights.

- Translate data into clear recommendations for both business and executive audiences.

- Promote data-driven decision-making across the organization.

AI, Automation & Innovation

- Identify opportunities to improve productivity and business outcomes through AI, automation, and emerging technologies.

- Design and implement solutions using tools such as Microsoft Copilot, Power Platform, ChatGPT, Claude, GitHub Copilot, and similar technologies.

- Develop automations, AI-assisted workflows, copilots, agents, and business solutions that reduce manual effort and accelerate results.

- Evaluate new technologies and recommend innovative solutions that align with business priorities.

- Champion AI adoption and help teams embrace new ways of working.

Solution Development & Leadership

- Lead rapid prototyping and proof-of-concept efforts to validate new ideas.

- Translate business needs into scalable technology and process solutions.

- Collaborate across business and technical teams to drive successful implementation and adoption.

- Serve as a trusted advisor on process optimization, analytics, automation, and AI-enabled transformation.

Job Level Specifications:
- Proven success leading cross-functional initiatives that deliver measurable business outcomes.

- Experience leveraging data, analytics, automation, and AI-enabled technologies to solve complex business challenges.

- Hands-on experience using AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, GitHub Copilot, or similar platforms to improve productivity, decision-making, or operational performance.

- Strong experience with Power BI or similar analytics and visualization platforms.

- Ability to translate business requirements into scalable solutions and drive organizational change.

- Strong analytical, communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.

Work Experience:
- Typically 8+ years with Bachelor's or equivalent.

Education and Certification(s):
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience from which comparable knowledge and job skills can be obtained.

Distinguishing Characteristics:
- E xperience in business process improvement, business transformation, analytics, operations, supply chain, consulting, or related fields.

- Experience building AI-assisted workflows, copilots, agents, automation solutions, or business applications.

- Experience with Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps) or similar low-code technologies.

- Familiarity with Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Azure, Snowflake, SQL, or modern data platforms.

- Experience leading AI adoption, digital transformation, innovation programs, or rapid prototyping initiatives.

- Experience in supply chain, sales operations, customer operations, logistics, or global business operations environments.

Job Summary:
Identifies opportunities for global business expansion in support of the customer offshore design and manufacturing. Develops and maintains the business relationship by providing solutions for the company and its defined supplier(s) in a product line, to achieve the identified strategy and business financial objectives. Planning and managing the migration of sales to meet product delivery, customer service, and revenue goals.

Principal Responsibilities:
- Provides value added solutions for the company and its defined supplier(s) growth plans and business.
- Responsible for planning and managing programs/projects to meet product delivery, customer service and revenue goals.
- Assist with coordinating sales and support team efforts in assigned accounts/territories/regions.
- Reviews customer requirements, identifies tasks, assigns and coordinates resources and creates/tracks project schedules.
- Ability to rapidly make prudent business decisions based on data analytics and craft sales and supply chain strategies.
- Collaborating between global sales teams, support teams, internal and external stakeholders globally.
- Responsible for the linkage between design and supply chains by connecting the design and fulfillment region resources and ensuring that design region resources are compensated based on pre-agreed norms.
- Tracks outbound manufacturing migrations for the company's customers.
- Gathering and documenting changes in such things as line card pricing, margins and revenue analysis.
- Updates and maintains critical business information in a databases which serve as the migration information system.
- Creates custom migration strategies for design region customers and executes based on set strategies.
- Ensures inter-regional margin splits are reported by fulfillment region so that the company's design and fulfillment regions share return-on-investment.
- Other duties as assigned.

Job Level Specifications:
- Foundational knowledge of specialized disciplines, industry practices and standards, acquired via academic instruction and/or relevant work experience of substantially the same level.
- Develops solutions to defined tasks, typical assignments and projects. May be solved by the application of specialized foundational knowledge, using existing approaches and solutions.
- Work is usually performed independently and requires the exercise of judgment and discretion. Receives initial direction although work may be reviewed for accuracy and quality.
- Collaborates with immediate management and team members within the department or function.

Work Experience:
- Typically less than 2 years with bachelor's or equivalent.

Education and Certification(s):
- Bachelors degree or equivalent experience from which comparable knowledge and job skills can be obtained.

jobs.title: Commercial Finance Manager
jobs.description:
Farnell

Farnell, an Avnet company, is a global high-service distributor of technology products, services and solutions for electronic system design, maintenance and repair.

Commercial Finance Manager
Location: Leeds Head Office – Canal Road
Business: Farnell (an Avnet company)
Reporting to: Senior Manager, FP&A

About Farnell
Farnell, an Avnet company, is a global distributor of electronic components, products and solutions, supporting engineers and businesses worldwide. Based at our Leeds head office on Canal Road, our finance team plays a critical role in providing insight, governance and commercial challenge to support strong decision‑making across a complex, fast‑moving organisation.

Job Summary
As Commercial Finance Manager, you will provide high‑quality financial analysis, forecasting and commercial insight to support business planning and performance management. Reporting to the Senior Manager, FP&A, you will act as a subject matter expert, partnering closely with senior stakeholders to interpret financial and operational data, develop models and scenarios, and influence strategic and commercial decisions.

This role requires a strong blend of technical finance expertise, commercial acumen and the confidence to operate independently in a senior, highly visible position.

Along with offering a competitive salary package, what's in it for you?
- A supportive team environment where everyone is working toward the same goal.
- A strong open-door policy within management
- An environment where you will be given the tools and opportunities to further your career
- A senior, influential role within an established FP&A and commercial finance function
- Direct exposure to business leaders and strategic initiatives
- Opportunity to shape financial planning, forecasting and performance reporting
- A role with real impact on commercial decisions and long‑range business outcomes
- Career development opportunities within Farnell and the wider Avnet organisation
- Pension scheme
- 25 days holiday plus bank holidays with the option to buy additional holiday
- FREE Onsite Parking
- Flexible hybrid working
- Reward schemes – i.e. EV Car Scheme

What will you be doing
- Providing analytical and commercial finance support to leaders across the global Farnell business, including P&L forecasting, investment appraisal, scenario planning, budgeting and cost analysis
- Developing financial forecasts, models and business cases to support strategic and operational decision‑making
- Conducting economic and financial analysis covering areas such as returns on investment, working capital, depreciation, investment performance and regulatory impacts
- Gathering, analysing and summarising data to support financial plans, acquisition activity, future requirements and operating forecasts
- Working closely with the regional accounting teams during month‑end close to provide insight, critique, challenge and review of financial performance in your areas of responsibility
- Producing high‑quality standard and ad‑hoc reporting, including trend analysis, forecasting, narrative commentary, bridge analysis and what-if scenarios
- Owning production and distribution of financial reports to ensure accuracy and integrity of results
- Partnering with management to develop, monitor and report on key performance indicators, including providing appropriate support and challenge (where required) to potential business decisions
- Supporting the development, preparation and presentation of short‑ and long‑range financial plans, including operating expense budgets for particular global functions
- Acting as a trusted advisor to stakeholders, providing insight, challenge and recommendations on complex financial matters

What about you
- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience, with typically 8+ years’ experience in business partnering, FP&A or a similar role
- Strong knowledge of GAAP and experience working with complex accounting and financial systems
- Proven ability to operate as a subject matter expert, advising management on complex financial and commercial issues
- Highly analytical, with strong financial modelling, forecasting and data interpretation skills
- Comfortable working independently, using sound judgement to evaluate options and make recommendations
- Confident communicator, able to translate complex financial information into clear, actionable insight for non-Finance senior stakeholders
- Experience influencing stakeholders and contributing to policy, process and reporting improvements

If this role interests you and you’re looking for a senior commercial finance role where your insight and judgement can make a real impact, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today to join Farnell’s Leeds‑based finance team and help shape informed, data‑driven business decisions.

- Develops solutions to complex problems where analysis of situations and/or data requires in-depth evaluation of variables. Determine best approach to achieve results and provide suggestions to improve policies and procedures.
- Work is performed independently and requires the exercise of judgment and discretion. Exercises considerable latitude in determining objectives and approaches to assignments. Work may be reviewed at a high-level.

Work Experience:

Education and Certification(s):

Distinguishing Characteristics:

- Position requires the ability to travel.
